description: This file defines the JmsListenerFactory class, which manages the creation, loading, refreshing, and closing of JMS message listeners within the Apache OFBiz framework. It creates listener instances dynamically based on service configurations, runs in a dedicated thread for continuous management, and provides external access to the loaded listeners.

classes.name: JmsListenerFactory
classes.description: Manages JMS message listeners for OFBiz, including dynamic loading, starting/stopping, and refresh capabilities, running as a thread.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Singleton accessor for JmsListenerFactory, ensures only one instance exists.

methods.name: JmsListenerFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes and starts the factory thread.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main loop running the thread, periodically loading listeners until all are connected.

methods.name: loadListeners
methods.description: Loads JMS listeners based on service configuration.

methods.name: loadListener
methods.description: Creates a specific JMS message listener for a given server configuration, loading class dynamically.

methods.name: loadListener (overload)
methods.description: Loads a listener given a server key, fetching server config and calling the main loader.

methods.name: closeListener
methods.description: Closes a specific JMS listener by server key.

methods.name: refreshListener
methods.description: Refreshes a specific JMS listener by server key.

methods.name: getJMSListeners
methods.description: Returns a map of current JMS listeners.
